title: Quickstart recoverable-error asset pack: modal set, inline banners, and retry UX
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a cohesive visual and interaction asset pack to surface recoverable errors during quickstart and onboarding flows. Focus areas: rate-limit messaging, client-side timeouts, and retry affordances. Deliverables include modal templates, compact inline banners, small-screen friendly screenshots, annotated design specs, and copy variants for tiered customers.
acceptance_criteria: Three modal variants: transient (toast), recoverable modal with retry button, and escalation modal with contact/support path
Inline compact banner component: fits in console quickstart left rail and mobile flow
Illustration set (3 icons) for rate-limited, timeout, and retry-success states
Accessible color contrast and keyboard focus states documented
Handoff package: Figma file, export-ready PNG/SVG assets, and a single-page MD spec in Drive
Design validated with one engineering implementation spike and QA checklist completed
design_notes: Avoid scary language: prefer 'Try again' and 'We’re retrying' instead of 'Error' for recoverable flows
Use a two-line pattern: one concise status line + one action/help line
Primary CTA color should be neutral brand-accent; secondary link to support is text-only
For rate limits, include estimated retry-after if available; otherwise show guidance and throttling explanation link
Small-screen variant collapses illustration into inline icon to save vertical space
progress_updates: 2025-06-12: Kickoff with PM and Eng — agreed scope and API surface for retry triggers (ENG will expose retryAfter/ms and requestId)
2025-06-18: First sketches completed — three modal sizes and an inline banner; shared Figma draft t/ drive link
2025-06-23: Design critique with Ben (PM) and Lila (Frontend) — feedback to reduce copy length and add 'soft-state' animation for retries
2025-06-30: Updated comps uploaded; started accessibility pass for contrast and keyboard focus
2025-07-02: Engineering spike complete; prototype wired to mock API in staging for 10-minute usability check
review_feedback: Ben Park (PM): Emphasize recoverability over fatality — move contact support into secondary flow
Lila Rivera (Frontend): Prefer css animation + aria-live region for retry notifications instead of full re-render
Samir Patel (Security): Confirm that retry metadata does not leak internal error traces into UI; sanitized messages only
QA (Olga): Add tests for focus trapping in modal and for screen-reader announcements on retry success/failure
handoff_tasks: Export SVGs + optimized PNGs from Figma and upload to Drive
Annotate component states and token spacing in the MD spec
Add example API responses (mock) for ENG to test retry flows
Coordinate with localization for three short copy variants (en, fr, de)
engineering_estimate: Frontend: 3 SP for modal + banner + animations; Backend: 2 SP for exposing retryAfter and sanitized message codes
ux_research_findings: Informal hallway test (5 engineers): users expect a single quick CTA — 'Try again' preferred
Operators want a visible requestId in modal for support escalations
Users confused by countdowns without context — must pair with short explanatory copy
accessibility_requirements: All messages must be announced via aria-live polite for transient notifications
Modal must trap focus and restore focus to triggering element on close
Contrast ratio minimum 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large headings
rollout_instructions: Phase 1: ship UI with mock retry headers behind feature flag (console-err-ux-2025.07) to 10% of orgs
Phase 2: enable backend headers and widen to 50% after monitoring for regression
Phase 3: full rollout with docs update in quickstart and troubleshooting pages
metrics_to_monitor: Quickstart completion rate (goal +5% after improved UX)
Rate-limit support escalations (should decrease if guidance is clear)
Average time-to-recover (from error to success) in staging
changelog: 2025-07-02: Engineering spike complete; prototype available in staging
notes: Keep copy neutral for freemium users; show tier-specific throttling guidance only when account info is known
If backend returns a quota window, show countdown only when accurate to within 10s to avoid confusing UX
Plan a follow-up ticket to add telemetry hooks in Console so PMs can see per-route error types
qa_checks: Verify modal focus trap and focus restore
Screen reader announces retry start and completion
Banner collapses correctly on small screens and does not push primary call-to-action off-screen
Color contrast verified against brand token palette
